I have been extremely glad to see your Birds, which certainly are marvels of their kind, though of less interest to me, than unimproved Birds, for certainly, strange as you may think it, I must think these Owls are descendants of the C. livia.—
With my cordial thanks for all your kindness, I beg leave to remain | Yours very sincerely |
